stem.text: Which diagram best shows how water waves diffract when they pass through a gap in a barrier?

A.alt: Plane wavefronts approaching a barrier with a gap, labelled gap and barrier; circular-arc wavefronts on the far side of the gap.

B.alt: Plane wavefronts approaching a barrier with a gap; arcs and arrows drawn on the far side of the gap.

C.alt: Plane wavefronts approaching a barrier with a gap; arcs and arrows drawn on the far side of the gap.

D.alt: Plane wavefronts approaching a barrier with a gap; straight wavefronts drawn on the far side of the gap.
